title: UnpackedRecord connection allocation and record decode

scope.rationale: These functions allocate the contiguous UnpackedRecord/Mem workspace from the owning connection and decode a record header into bounded Mem fields using the serial-format helpers, including malformed payload nulling.

dependencies.caller_closure: Both active allocation and unpack functions are assigned. Exact KeyInfo/UnpackedRecord/Mem owners and serial/varint dependencies are covered; comparison callers remain follow-on work.

inputs: KeyInfo with nKeyField/db; encoded record byte count/pointer and allocated UnpackedRecord capacity
outputs: contiguous record plus nKeyField+1 Mem capacity; decoded fields, count, and default_rc=0
contracts.ownership: The allocation is one connection-owned block; aMem is an interior aligned view and must not be separately freed. Decoded text/blob values are ephemeral views into caller-owned record bytes.
contracts.state_and_results: Allocator publishes pKeyInfo, aligned aMem, and capacity. Unpack initializes enc/db/szMalloc/z before each serial decode, stops at header/data/capacity bounds, and publishes actual nField.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No callback or I/O; allocation caller holds connection mutex.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Allocation OOM returns null with sticky connection OOM and no partial owner. If declared field payload exceeds logical nKey, the last decoded field is overwritten with NULL before publishing count.

representation_differences: ROUND8P is the identical `(size+7)&~7` interior offset with an explicit Zig alignment assertion.
The source pointer correction in malformed-record cleanup always selects the last decoded field and is expressed directly as field_count-1.

oracle.protocol: The shared worker allocates a four-field workspace and checks one-block interior layout, disables lookaside and forces allocation OOM, decodes a mixed signed/text/NULL record, then decodes a logically truncated 64-bit field from physically safe fixture storage and verifies NULL overwrite. C and Zig compare 366 observations.
internal_observations: signed scalar and ephemeral text fields
malformed final-field NULL and cleared ownership state
oracle.normalization: Interior pointer normalizes to exact expected offset; external addresses are not compared. Flags, values, counts, text pointer identity, and OOM state are exact.

assurance.oom: No-lookaside first allocation failure returns null and sets sticky OOM without partial publication.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O/callback; connection mutex remains caller obligation.
assurance.malformed_input: Logical truncation is exercised with physically initialized backing bytes, matching source corrupt-record NULL repair without undefined fixture access.
assurance.continuation: Successful blocks are connection-freed once; decoded values remain valid until input bytes expire; OOM is explicitly cleared before continuation.
assurance.performance: Single contiguous allocation and one header pass preserve source shape and avoid per-field allocation.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker reaches exact allocator, KeyInfo, UnpackedRecord, Mem, varint, and serial decode paths. Comparison/opcode callers remain partially handwritten.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Integrate record comparison and index opcode consumers.

independent_review.notes: Requires record comparison/opcode integration, assurance closure, and independent review.
